title: Soil Viral Extraction Protocol for ssDNA & dsDNA Viruses
author: Gary Trubl
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tzzep76
materials: Pipet supernatant into a new 50 ml tube.
Have all supernatant collected into one tube.
Quantify DNA with PicoGreen or Qubit (~2 µl).

steps.title: Perform Initial Soil Resuspension
steps.instruction: In a 4°C cold room, add 25 ml of AKC' buffer to the soil sample, ensuring the sample is supersaturated and recording the recovery amount.

substeps.instruction: Place on shaker at 400 rpm for 15 minutes at 4°C
Perform three cycles of: vortexing for 1 min on the highest setting followed by manual shaking for 30 s at 4°C
Centrifuge tubes for 20 minutes at 15,000 g at 4°C to pellet soil and plant debris

steps.title: Perform Second Soil Resuspension
steps.instruction: Repeat the resuspension process on the same initial soil material using 25 ml of AKC' buffer in a 4°C cold room.

substeps.instruction: Place on shaker at 400 rpm for 15 minutes at 4°C
Perform three cycles of: vortexing for 1 min on the highest setting followed by manual shaking for 30 s at 4°C
Centrifuge tubes for 20 minutes at 15,000 g at 4°C to pellet soil and plant debris

steps.title: Perform Third Soil Resuspension
steps.instruction: Perform the final resuspension on the same initial soil material using 25 ml of AKC' buffer in a 4°C cold room.

substeps.instruction: Place on shaker at 400 rpm for 15 minutes at 4°C
Perform three cycles of: vortexing for 1 min on the highest setting followed by manual shaking for 30 s at 4°C
Centrifuge tubes for 20 minutes at 15,000 g at 4°C to pellet soil and plant debris

steps.title: Filter and Store Supernatant
steps.instruction: Filter the supernatant into new 50 ml tubes using a 0.22 or 0.45 µm vacuum filter to remove microbes.

substeps.instruction: Use fewer filters to minimize virus loss
Store the resulting filtrate at 4°C overnight

steps.title: Prepare Amicon Filters
steps.instruction: Prepare the Amicon filters for sample concentration.

substeps.instruction: Incubate 2 ml of 1% BSA on the Amicon filter for 1 hour
Centrifuge filters at 1,000 g for 10 min (or until all BSA filters through)
Wash filters by centrifuging with 2 ml 1x PBS at 1,000 g for 10 min (or until all PBS is filtered through)

steps.title: Concentrate Viral Samples
steps.instruction: Concentrate the samples using the prepared Amicon filters to approximately 5 ml for CsCl purification.

substeps.instruction: Store concentrated samples at 4°C overnight

steps.title: Extract Viral DNA
steps.instruction: Extract DNA using the PowerSoil DNA extraction kit.

substeps.instruction: Omit the beads but continue to use the bead solution
Perform alternative heat lysis

steps.title: Process and Quality Control DNA
steps.instruction: Prepare the extracted DNA for downstream analysis.

substeps.instruction: Transfer a portion of DNA into a new tube for a working sample
Check for microbial contamination using qPCR 16S analyses (~3 µl)
Allocate 50 µl for shearing (use Swift kit for ssDNA viruses or Nextera XT for dsDNA viruses)
If resizing is required, use AMPure beads (as used in the Swift kit) or a Pippin prep
